scope: Generated sentences re-checked by the package gate
title: Generated sentences pass the gate
description: Of 2,000 sentences requested in one run, 1,966 different ones came back and every one passed the validity gate.
claim: Of 2,000 sentences requested in one run, 1,966 different ones came back. Every one passed the package's validity gate on a fresh parse, and every word in every one was observed in the corpus.

headline.label: generated sentences that passed the validity gate on re-parse
sentences in which every word was observed in the corpus
sentences that were different from every other

method.workload: 8,232 sentences from 3 public-domain novels (Alice's Adventures in Wonderland; The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; Pride and Prejudice) are mined, then 2,000 sentences are generated with a fixed seed.
engines: Prose ProseEngine.Generate, checked with ValidityGate.Check and Attested.All
method.verification: Every sentence is parsed again by the same rules that mined the text and must have a real subject and a finite verb, with subject and verb agreement and article and noun agreement. A separate check confirms every open-class word was observed in the corpus.
method.tie: The corpus is large enough for generation to use observed pairings only.

tables.caption: 2,000 sentences requested in one run
rows: Every word observed in the corpus

losses: The package returned 1,966 of the 2,000 requested sentences. It returns up to the number asked for and stops when it cannot find more different valid ones.
limits: The gate checks form, using the same rules that produced the sentences. It does not check meaning, and a valid sentence can still say something odd.
